name: Cephilith Priest
description: A perpetually moist, faceless humanoid from the Outer Realms who has elongated fingers and translucent skin, under which one can see wriggling worms.
motivesTactics: prepare this world for the Cephilith Titan’s arrival

abilities.name: Psychic Blast
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs within Close range and force them to make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 2d10+5 direct magic damage. Targets who fail take 4d10+10 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

abilities.name: Cerebral Incursion
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a Vulnerable target within Melee range. The Priest grabs the target and inserts their elongated fingers into the target’s ears, nose, and mouth. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d6 Stress, and the Priest clears an equal number of Stress.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Grasp
abilities.description: When the Priest makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they spend a Hope.
